verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's docs list Cloudflare Images as a platform service that can "store, optimize, and deliver images", so a built-in optimization and delivery pipeline exists alongside Workers. That is a single thin mention: the pack never shows on-demand resizing, transformation parameters, or how a Worker calls the service. Missing for 10: documented on-demand resize/transform options, documented Workers integration (binding or URL transforms), CDN delivery details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can resize and optimize images on demand via a built-in image CDN

citations.quote: Cloudflare Images helps teams build scalable, reliable media pipelines to store, optimize, and deliver images.
